description: Protocols and entities tracked on ZScan's Protocols page. Addresses come from labels/addresses.json (curated, each with a public source), consensus rules, coinbase signatures and the protocols' own public APIs. PRs welcome.

protocols.name: Ironwood Pool
protocols.description: Shielded pool introduced by NU6.3, with quantum-recoverable notes. New shielded activity lands here.

protocols.name: Orchard Pool
protocols.description: Halo 2 shielded pool from NU5. Since NU6.3 funds can only leave, through a turnstile.

protocols.name: Sapling Pool
protocols.description: Shielded pool from the 2018 Sapling upgrade.

protocols.name: Sprout Pool
protocols.description: The original shielded pool, closed to new deposits since Canopy.

protocols.name: Coinholder Fund (Lockbox)
protocols.description: 12% of block rewards, held by consensus in the lockbox and allocated by coinholder votes (ZIP 1016).

protocols.name: Zcash Community Grants
protocols.description: 8% of block rewards, paid by consensus to the ZCG funding-stream addresses (ZIP 1016).

protocols.name: Maya Protocol
protocols.description: Cross-chain liquidity protocol with a native ZEC pool. Vault addresses are read from Maya's public API.

protocols.name: NEAR Intents
protocols.description: Cross-chain swaps through NEAR. ZEC deposited on Zcash is minted on NEAR as zec.omft.near; holdings are that token's total supply, read from NEAR.
